title: Past-Due Amount Worksheet — Community Rules & Site Care Statement
content:
On a Community Rules & Site Care plan record, the past-due payment is worked out from the rules and site-care statement.

**Statement balance.** The statement balance is every plan fee, self-help charge, repeat-violation charge, pet registration fee and vehicle permit fee on the plan record's statement, less every payment and waiver on it.

**When a charge is past due.** A charge counts as past due once 1 full calendar month has passed since the date it is dated, so the charges dated within the 1 calendar month ending on the handling date are not yet past due.

**Past-due payment.** The past-due payment is the statement balance less the charges not yet past due, never less than zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked example

Hypothetical statement, handling date 9 October:

| Entry | Dated | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Plan fee | 1 August | $59.00 |
| Payment | 5 August | $59.00 |
| Plan fee | 1 September | $59.00 |
| Self-help charge | 20 September | $85.00 |
| Plan fee | 1 October | $59.00 |

- Statement balance: charges of $262.00 less the $59.00 payment, which is $203.00.
- Charges dated within the 1 calendar month ending on 9 October: the self-help charge of 20 September and the plan fee of 1 October, $144.00 together.
- Past-due payment: $203.00 less $144.00, which is $59.00.

## The zero floor

Hypothetical statement balance of $40.00 with $95.00 of charges dated within the month ending on the handling date: the balance less those charges would fall below zero, so the past-due payment is $0.00.
